about_the_game:
This is the free demo of BitHero Survivors, a survivors-like pixel-art action RPG.

Choose from a roster of unique heroes and battle through relentless waves of enemies in fast-paced bullet heaven combat!

Features available in the Demo:

  • 2 distinct heroes and 6 starting weapons

  • Discover powerful weapon evolutions - hero-exclusive weapons can evolve twice for greater power

  • 8 relics to enhance your builds

  • Face swarms of quirky foes (mushrooms!?)

  • Open treasure chests to gain bonus experience and power up faster

  • Includes the first stage — replay it endlessly with different heroes, weapons, and strategies

Planned for the Full Release:

  • Unlock an even larger roster of heroes, weapons, and relics

  • Expanded stages with unique layouts, randomized rewards, and new challenges

  • Expanded armor system — collect multiple armor sets across different slots, each with unique stats and synergies

  • In-game shops and loot progression — discover, purchase, and upgrade equipment to customize your hero builds

  • Additional systems and content to deepen long-term progression

Survive. Upgrade. Become a true hero!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
